rule: Offer a neighbouring heading as “Also possible” only when it and the answer are a documented pair with a deciding fact (the disputes CBP's rulings turn on, such as 9617 against 7323), or when the first stage gives it at least `floor` of probability and it has real support (it shares the answer's chapter, or one of the product's ten closest rulings is held under it). `floor` is the lowest value on the declared grid at which the alternatives shown on validation are the right heading at least 25% of the time (over at least 20 shown); none is shown if no value qualifies.
test: not read; the floor decides only what is displayed
history: The documented-pair clause was added once, before this floor was chosen, after the first sweep dropped the vacuum question from a tumbler described without the word vacuum; the floor was then chosen again on validation under the amended rule. The test set was never read for it.
